metadata.description: Oh-My-Pi plugins: an agentic dev team, a GitHub Copilot model preset, command-output filters, an Azure DevOps filesystem, an OpenAI-compatible provider, and Datadog observability.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Verbatim port of bdfinst/agentic-dev-team v10.20.0 to Oh-My-Pi: orchestrator + 45 specialist/critic agents, 93 skills including /ship (spec->plan->build->review->PR as one idempotent command), a 58-file knowledge corpus, and upstream's 38 Python hook invocations run unmodified through a protocol bridge. 456 of 567 upstream files are byte-identical; the rest carry only the Claude Code -> OMP format conversion, applied by a re-runnable converter so the next upstream bump is one command. Model-open: agents route through OMP roles, never a vendor id. Requires python3.

plugins.name: azure-devops-fs
plugins.description: Azure DevOps as a filesystem for OMP: read repos/files/PRs/diffs via ado:// URIs, create/checkout/push PRs, comment/vote, watch pipelines. Standalone, PAT-authenticated, with a SQLite read cache.

plugins.name: copilot-preset
plugins.description: Ready model configuration that routes OMP (and the dev-team) through GitHub Copilot, so teams run on their Copilot license. Config-only: paste the snippet. Covers every OMP role that resolves - default/plan/smol/task/slow/designer/vision/advisor - with the July 2026 catalog and rates, the vision role wired (inspect_image hard-errors on a text-only model), and Kimi K2.7, the catalog's only open-weight model, as a documented opt-in.

plugins.name: token-diet
plugins.description: Command-output filtering for OMP: ctx-wire filters that collapse dotnet publish/pack/run/tool output semantically (OMP truncates mechanically - 50KB tail, 768-byte column cap), including French locales, plus the caveman skill for terse agent output. Deliberately small: OMP 17 absorbed read/context dedup, cost and prompt-cache statusline segments, secret redaction and MCP-as-CLI, so those were removed rather than duplicated.

plugins.name: openai-compatible
plugins.description: Register any OpenAI-compatible provider (LiteLLM, Ollama, vLLM, LocalAI, ...) in Oh-My-Pi. Supply a provider name, base URL, and API key; the installer lists the models and writes the provider into ~/.omp/agent/models.yml with runtime discovery, so any model the endpoint exposes is usable as <name>/<model-id>. API key stored chmod 600, never in env.

plugins.name: datadog
plugins.description: Datadog observability from the terminal via the Datadog 'pup' CLI (DataDog/pup): logs, metrics, traces/APM, monitors, incidents, dashboards, SLOs, synthetics, RUM, security/audit, CI test visibility, and LLM/agent observability. One broad 'datadog' skill drives pup (which embeds Datadog's domain skills) instead of flooding OMP. Installer sets up pup + auth.
